items.title: Document the canonical owner-session contract
items.context: Define LATTICE_SESSION_ID as the core owner lease identity, separate host-specific session env from core owner lease logic, and explain why ppid-derived identity is only a last-resort fallback.

items.title: Define host adapter bridge and future-host onboarding rules
items.context: Specify how Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts bridge stable native session identifiers into LATTICE_SESSION_ID without adding host-specific special cases to owner lease core.

items.title: Define verification and rollout plan with two-host review
items.context: Specify tests and smoke coverage for ppid-changing command invocations, wrapper env bridging, owner lease refresh behavior, session_brief source rendering, and independent 2-host review evidence before implementation proceeds.
